prompt:
Paint ONE finished frame of a film-like cutscene of our hand-painted point-and-click adventure game 'Posledny zvonec' (Slovakia; eras 1960, 1982, 1995, 2020, 2035). The reference images are numbered in the order they are given: Image 1: place reference: the residential street of our game (room S02, autumn 2020) Image 2: character reference: Lenka and her dog Bodka (the white dog with black spots) Image 3: prop reference: the chewed red ball

Shot: Low, close shot on the pavement of the street: Bodka, the white short-haired dog with her black spots, lies contentedly on the warm pavement with the chewed red ball between her front paws, chin on the ball, tail mid-wag. Beside her stand Lenka's legs in jeans and brown ankle boots, the leash slack, and Lenka bends a little, smiling above her blue face mask. Fallen leaves.

Characters in this frame (briefs of the approved designs): Lenka, a 37-year-old Slovak neighbour walking her dog in 2020: economical with words, quietly amused. Chin-length dark auburn bob, a few freckles. She wears a plain mid-grey zipped soft-shell jacket without any logo, dark blue jeans and brown ankle boots. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers her nose and mouth (autumn 2020, outdoors among people). In her near hand she holds a tan leather leash that runs down to her dog Bodka, who stands at her feet in front of her, facing the same way: a medium-sized short-haired white mixed-breed dog with exactly one round black spot on its side, black nose, floppy ears, alert and eager, looking ahead as if it would rather run.

Light and time: Warm golden October afternoon sun, long soft shadows.

Character references show approved characters of the game on a plain grey card: copy each person's face, age, hair, body proportions, clothes and colours exactly, but pose and light them for this scene; never copy the grey card, the sheet layout or a duplicate of the same person. Place references show the real location and its painted version in our game: keep its architecture, materials and era. Photos are only references: repaint everything in our style, paint any real people in them out, and do not copy brand logos or shop names. Composition: a calm 16:9 picture like a still from the last minutes of a film, with a clear focal point and depth; it is shown whole with a caption below it, so keep the subject well inside the frame. One single image: no panels, no split screen, no border, no frame, no captions, no subtitles, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no UI, unless the shot asks for it. No text or lettering anywhere unless the shot quotes it exactly.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
